pages.text: "Grub, I bet you are sick of mud," said Yara.
pages.picture: girl talking to the mud monster

pages.text: "I am," said Grub. "Mud in my hair. Mud in my ears. Mud on my feet."
pages.picture: grumpy mud monster covered in mud
girl pointing at the baby dragon

pages.text: Fizz huffs and puffs. A hot wind fills the bog.
pages.picture: baby dragon blowing warm wind over the bog

pages.text: The mud gets hard. It cracks. Then Grub is not wet at all.
pages.picture: dry cracked mud and a happy clean monster

pages.text: Grub grins. "Thank you!" he said. "You can go past my bog."
pages.picture: monster grinning and waving them past

pages.text: Yara and Fizz run on. Dragon Hill is near.
pages.picture: girl and dragon running toward a hill
